title: The Nightly Rate a Retained Resort Lodging Night Is Priced At
content:
The nightly rate the retained nights of a Resort Lodging stay are priced at follows what the household was actually paying. Two things are read: the household's season passes under the Season Pass Programme, for their standing and the season they are held for, and the room rate entries standing on the reservation's folio.

Where a season pass stands active for the season of the stay on the household account and the folio carries the room rate posted for the stay, the retained nights are priced at the nightly average of that room rate, which is the room rate standing on the folio divided by the number of entries it was posted in.

Where a season pass stands active for that season and the folio carries no room rate posted for the stay, they are priced at the published nightly rate of the window the stay falls in, less the unit type's passholder reduction.

Where no season pass stands active for that season, they are priced at the published nightly rate of the window the stay falls in.

A nightly rate worked out under any of those three readings is a working figure and not an amount posted to a folio: it is carried at full precision, is never rounded on its own, and reaches the cent only through the amount the entry is posted at.

| Season pass standing active for the season | Room rate posted on the folio | The nightly rate used |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | the nightly average of the room rate standing on the folio |
| yes | no | the published nightly rate of the window the stay falls in, less the unit type's passholder reduction |
| no | either | the published nightly rate of the window the stay falls in |

### Three hypothetical stays

A household holding a season pass standing active for the season of the stay, on a folio carrying 1800.00 USD of room rate posted in 2 entries, has the retained nights priced at 900.00 USD a night, being 1800.00 USD divided by the 2 entries it was posted in.

A household holding the same pass, on a folio carrying no room rate posted for the stay, has the retained nights priced at the published nightly rate of the window the stay falls in less the unit type's passholder reduction; where that published rate is 629.00 USD and the reduction 12.5 percent, the nights are priced at 550.375 USD each.

A household with no season pass standing active for that season has the retained nights priced at the published nightly rate of the window the stay falls in, whatever the folio carries.
